subject: Joey Saputo puts CF Montreal up for sale after 34 years of family ownership
title: Montreal for sale, no price on the tag

lines.vo: Thirty-four years of ownership, and now CF Montreal are up for sale.
lines.footage: CF Montreal Saputo sale news, Stade Saputo exterior

lines.vo: Joey Saputo says it is time to find new ownership. The family has owned the club since nineteen ninety-two.
lines.footage: Joey Saputo press conference, CF Montreal

lines.vo: Montreal finished last in the East, with twenty-six points. Six wins in thirty-four games. Not the glossiest sales brochure.
lines.footage: CF Montreal highlights 2026, Eastern Conference table

lines.vo: They fired Marco Donadel in April, their eleventh manager in fourteen seasons. Some people change phones less often.
lines.footage: Marco Donadel CF Montreal sideline, press conference

lines.vo: Saputo prefers a local buyer, but may accept a relocation offer. Plan A, and a very polite Plan B.
lines.footage: Montreal fans and stadium, Saputo interview clip

lines.vo: BMO Capital Markets and National Bank Financial are advising. No price has been given. Plenty of bankers, no number.
lines.footage: CF Montreal Saputo sale, business news graphic

lines.vo: Last in the table, eleven managers, one for-sale sign. Montreal do like a theme.

notes: Non-comic, 0 inserts, kokoro. Family ownership is stated as a fact only, with no joke on the family. Jokes target results and the managerial turnover. Relocation remark is the report's own wording, kept as a hint, not a threat. 'Eleventh manager in fourteen seasons' as in ev0042.
